name: shopee-api
description: Shopee seller shop via the Shopee Open Platform v2: products, stock and prices, orders, shipping and seller chat

nodes.title: Get Shopee shop info
nodes.description: Read the authorized Shopee shop: name, region, status, authorization expiry and cross-border flags.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Shopee items
nodes.description: List the shop's item ids with status and update time (offset paging). Use get_item_base_info for details.

update_time_from.description: Only items updated at or after this Unix time (seconds)

update_time_to.description: Only items updated at or before this Unix time (seconds)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Shopee item details
nodes.description: Read base info (name, status, price info, stock info, images) for up to 50 items.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update Shopee stock
nodes.description: Set seller stock for an item or its models (variations). Check failure_list in the result for models Shopee rejected. If this failed with a network error the update may still have been applied: check with get_item_base_info before retrying.

stock_list.description: Entries {model_id (0 or omitted for items without models), stock, location_id (only for multi-warehouse shops)}, e.g. [{"model_id": 0, "stock": 25}]

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Update Shopee price
nodes.description: Set the original price of an item or its models (variations). Check failure_list in the result. If this failed with a network error the update may still have been applied: check with get_item_base_info before retrying.

price_list.description: Entries {model_id (0 or omitted for items without models), original_price}, e.g. [{"model_id": 0, "original_price": 150000}]

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Shopee orders
nodes.description: List order numbers created or updated in a time window of at most 15 days (Unix seconds), optionally by status.

time_to.description: Window end, Unix seconds; at most 15 days after time_from

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Shopee order details
nodes.description: Read up to 50 orders: items, amounts, buyer, recipient address, packages and shipping carrier.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Shopee shipping parameters
nodes.description: Read what ship_order needs for an order (info_needed) and the pickup addresses/time slots or drop-off branches.

package_number.description: Package number, only for orders split into several packages

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Ship a Shopee order
nodes.description: Arrange shipment for an order with exactly one of pickup, dropoff or non_integrated, as get_shipping_parameter's info_needed says. If this fails with a network error the order may still have been shipped: check with get_tracking_number or get_order_detail before retrying.

package_number.description: Package number, only for orders split into several packages

pickup.description: {address_id, pickup_time_id, tracking_number?}; send {} if info_needed lists pickup with no fields

dropoff.description: {branch_id?, sender_real_name?, tracking_number?, slug?}; send {} if no fields are needed

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get Shopee tracking number
nodes.description: Read the tracking number of a shipped order (empty until the carrier assigns one).

package_number.description: Package number, only for orders split into several packages

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List Shopee chat conversations
nodes.description: List the shop's buyer chat conversations, newest first, with unread counts and the latest message.

outputs.name: data

nodes.title: Get Shopee chat messages
nodes.description: Read messages of one chat conversation, newest first.

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Send a Shopee chat message
nodes.description: Send one message to a buyer: text, an image URL, an item card or an order card. Not for bulk messages. If this fails with a network error the message may have been sent: check sellerchat_get_message before retrying.

image_url.description: Image URL from Shopee's upload_image, for message_type image

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Refresh Shopee access token
nodes.description: Exchange the shop's refresh token for a new access token (valid 4 hours) and a new refresh token (valid 30 days, single use): store both. The partner key is read from SHOPEE_PARTNER_KEY only.

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Shopee Open Platform v2 request
nodes.description: Call any Shopee Open Platform v2 endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/api/v2/product/get_category". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/api/v2/product/get_category"

api_type.description: shop = signed with access_token and shop_id (most APIs); public = partner-level APIs signed without them

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: data
outputs.description: API result

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
